purpose: Compare four small, predeclared, safety-aware scorers on the frozen Gold V2 component-group 3-fold split. This specification is committed before any A2D outer-test evaluation.
outer_evaluation: COMPONENT_GROUP_3FOLD; unchanged A2C fold assignment and fingerprint

inner_selection.data: Only the two non-outer folds within each outer training partition
selection_order: minimize inner OOF P3 hard-negative contamination
minimize inner OOF false-family and cross-family clusters
prefer the more conservative deterministic parameter tuple

families.name: A_SEMANTIC_LEXICAL_CONFIRMATION
families.rule_class: monotonic conjunction: qwen >= T_sem AND title overlap >= T_lex
families.rationale: Require semantic similarity and independent lexical corroboration.
families.runtime_dependency: local Qwen embedding feature plus deterministic title-token overlap

families.name: B_SEMANTIC_TEMPORAL_CONFIRMATION
families.rule_class: monotonic conjunction: qwen >= T_sem AND publication delta <= T_hours
families.rationale: Test whether temporal proximity adds within-P3 separation without relaxing P3's frozen 24h maximum span.
families.runtime_dependency: local Qwen embedding feature plus existing article timestamps

families.name: C_SEMANTIC_LOW_CORROBORATION_VETO
families.rule_class: qwen threshold followed by a general veto when lexical overlap < 0.25, entity-anchor overlap < 0.25, number overlap == 0, and date overlap == 0

train_only_parameters.veto_constants: fixed in this preregistration; not fitted to any outer fold

families.rationale: Reject semantic-only matches that lack every existing deterministic title corroboration signal.
families.runtime_dependency: local Qwen embedding feature plus deterministic title-derived features

families.name: D_LIGHTWEIGHT_LOGISTIC_REFERENCE
families.rule_class: StandardScaler plus L2 LogisticRegression; threshold selected from inner OOF scores using the same safety-first selection order
families.rationale: Small learned reference using already materialized pair features; no model-class escalation.
families.runtime_dependency: scikit-learn research dependency plus local Qwen embedding feature; research-only

downstream_evaluation.clusterer: frozen P3; max cluster size 10; max temporal span 24h; strong multi-member support; no multi-cluster bridging
downstream_evaluation.safety_gate: zero RELATED_TOPIC and DIFFERENT_EVENT P3 contamination; zero false-family merges; zero cross-family clusters
downstream_evaluation.home_shadow: only candidates passing both the OOF coverage and safety gates; no product activation

prohibited: pair-ID, title, URL, source-name or observed-error-specific rules
new model downloads or external article-content APIs
product integration, persistent state, Miniflux writes, deployment or canary
